ProjectRef.description:
A project: a workspace with a lead and its own directory, on its home machine, where the lead runs. Its
`projectId` is the node's id for that directory, so the ref also addresses the files; the directory may be a git
repo or a plain folder. A project holds zero or more repos (`ProjectRepo`), each in a node directory of its
own or in the project's.

ProviderTrouble.description: A provider's trouble now, in plain words: never a path, a status code or any part of the key.

fix.description: What to do about it, in plain words.

message.description: What is wrong: "boat.dev refused: billing isn't set up on the account".

until.description: When its agents are tried there again by themselves; only for `start`.

ProviderTroubleKind.description:
What a machine found wrong with a connected provider just now: `start`, it refused a sandbox or one didn't come up
there, so none is asked of it until `until`; `keep_alive`, its running sandboxes couldn't be kept running.

SandboxCheckReason.description:
Why a hosted sandbox provider's key failed its last check, as a word the app acts on: `invalid_key` (the provider
refused it), `limit` (the account is at its plan's limit), `billing` (the account can't pay), `unreachable` (the
provider didn't answer), `failed` (anything else, or no machine could test it).

SandboxProvider.description: A hosted sandbox provider a team connects with its own key.

SlotHosted.description: A connected hosted provider on the board.

limit.description: Its limit: how many of the team's agents may run there at once.

running.description: Its sandboxes live now, across the team's machines.

SlotSandbox.description: Where the machine's agents run, as its node last said: in a VM of their own each (`microvm`), or as plain processes (`process`) with the reason, the command that fixes it where a person has one, and `expected` when that is by choice or the machine's design (turned off, macOS). Absent from a node that doesn't say (older, or the agents' Mac).

accountsOnly.description:
In VMs, but only agents on a Claude account of their bot's: the machine signs in to Claude with its own login,
which never goes into a VM, so a bot with none runs its agents as plain processes there.

detail.description:
What a person looks into only when they want to (the last VM's console when one didn't come up), behind the
plain `why`: never in it. Cut with an ellipsis past 2000 characters.

expected.description: The plain processes are by choice or the machine's design: nothing to fix.

fix.description: The command that fixes it, run on the machine.

why.description: Why its agents run as plain processes, whole (cut with an ellipsis past 600 characters).

cap.description: Agents running at once across every project: `fleetCap` when set, else the sum of the machines' caps.

fleetCap.description: The fleet cap a person (or an older hub) saved; absent: none beyond the machines' own caps.

hosted.description: Each connected hosted provider, in the order agents go to them: its sandboxes live now and what is wrong there.

SlotStatePerMachine.description: One machine's share of the board: what it fits, and what runs there.

auto.description:
What the machine fits: one agent per CPU less a reserve, and 2 GB of memory each after the OS's share, at
most 64.

cap.description: The most agents that run on it at once: a person's setting for the machine, else `auto`.

diskRoom.description: New agents its free disk has room for now, above the guard's floor; absent while the node reports no disk.

maxAgents.description: A person's setting for the machine (`cap_set`); absent: it runs `auto`.

why.description: The term that sets `auto`, e.g. "memory 18 GB, about 2 GB an agent" or "14 of 16 CPUs".

maxAgents.description:
The most of the project's agents (its tasks: writers, readers, reviewers) that run at once; its lead is not
one. Until set, the default: its machine's `cap`, within the fleet cap.

own.description:
A person set the project's own max; false: it follows the default. Absent from a hub before this, which
listed a project only once set or busy.

queued.description: Its agents waiting for a slot, paused ones included.

running.description: Its agents running now. Above `maxAgents` right after the cap was lowered: nothing is stopped for it.
